title: Yellow-Mc
description: A Yellow-focused minecraft texture designed for SMP's
body:
Yellow-Mc Resource Pack 
A Minecraft texture pack that Adds A Ton Of New Textures To items Main Screen And UI's with this pack you can enjoy A Yellow Pack Minecraft Experiance On Your SMP's 

## Features✨:

- A cool Yellow background.
- Yellow minecraft Title.
- Yellow ingame ui for food and xp.
- Yellow Server screen 
- Yellow server list
- Yellow end sky glow
- Yellow sweep particals
- Yellow mojang studios screen (with puzzle mod)
- Clear end sky
- Clear Watter
- Full crops notifi
- No eating paticals
- No explosion particals
- And More soon...
- Mods support like
[Modmenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) [VoiceChat](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-voice-chat) [Apple skin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin) ...

![ui](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1479127559286296576/1514998150878728313/image.png?ex=6a2d677a&is=6a2c15fa&hm=ccd0092eb1997409bd2063645cffd54a51d0d39e82721eac8fd31c00484aea7f&)
  
you need [Apple skin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin) for the food bar to work
